title: UI/UX Designer
note: The advert lists all seven as required. The split below was proposed by Claude and approved by the user on 2026-11-24. "3-5 years" is read as "at least 3".

requirements.text: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science or a related field
3 or more years of experience as a UI/UX designer in a software or tech company
Proficiency in design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch or InVision
A portfolio showing strong UI/UX design skills and real-world project experience
Strong understanding of user-centred design principles, responsive design and accessibility standards
Experience collaborating with front-end developers and product teams
Ability to present and explain design concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
